threat_event: Ransomware enters through a legacy vendor remote-support tool and encrypts site supervisors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on tools with a shared vendor account and no MFA on site supervisors at 47 sites
existing_controls: Gateway for most sessions; EDR on central components
treatment_plan: Remove all legacy tools; gateway only; block the vendors' relay services at site firewalls
owner: Group OT security lead

threat_event: Malware on building IT reaches BAS and access control devices on flat networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT devices share networks with building IT at 81 of 142 owned properties
existing_controls: Site firewalls at the internet edge; EDR on managed PCs
treatment_plan: OT zones with deny-by-default rules at every property (SP 800-82 Rev. 3 zones and conduits)
owner: Group OT security lead

threat_event: Default or shared passwords on field controllers and video recorders are used to change setpoints or view video
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Defaults found on 14 field controller models at older sites; shared local accounts
treatment_plan: Change defaults at all sites; vault local credentials
owner: Group OT security lead

threat_event: A site supervisor on an unsupported operating system is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 58 site supervisors past vendor support; 212 on older software
treatment_plan: Replace unsupported supervisors; OT patch standard
owner: Group OT security lead

threat_event: Site programs cannot be rebuilt after loss because the only copy is in the BTI repository
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 40% of site configurations and controller programs held only in SYS-D5
treatment_plan: Export all site programs to the group vault after each change; quarterly restore test per region
owner: Group building technology director

threat_event: Engineers cannot run buildings safely by hand during a long supervision outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual operating procedures exist at about half of the properties
treatment_plan: Manual operating procedures per property; annual drill
owner: Commercial Property vice president of engineering

threat_event: Internet-exposed video recorders or BAS web interfaces are found and exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 recorders reachable from the internet in the P07 scan; port forwarding by former guard contractor
treatment_plan: Close exposures; remote viewing only through the platform
owner: Group OT security lead

threat_event: Former tenant employees keep building access because badges are not revoked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Revocation depends on tenants; 9,400 tenant badges unused for over 90 days
treatment_plan: Auto-suspend badges unused for 90 days; quarterly tenant attestations
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: Visitor ID scans kept indefinitely are breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule in SYS-D2 since 2022
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))
treatment_plan: 30-day retention and purge of ID scans
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: Tailgating analytics produce biased or noisy alerts that lead officers to stop some people more than others
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-enabled feature at 23 properties without assessment; false alerts concentrated on accessible lanes
treatment_plan: Conditions in P10: review-only alerts on accessible lanes; precision and recall targets; vendor training opt-out
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: Face verification creates biometric data and denies tenants entry on false matches
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot at 2 towers with about 1,900 enrolled; automatic denial on mismatch; consent and retention not defined
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))
existing_controls: Opt-in enrollment; guards at the lanes
treatment_plan: Suspend automatic denial; consent and retention rules; bias testing; council decision (P10)
owner: Group Chief Privacy Officer

threat_event: The BAS optimization service drives unsafe or uncomfortable conditions
threat_source: AI model error or vendor compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Writes setpoints automatically at 41 buildings; not reviewed; no SOC report
existing_controls: Setpoint ranges limited by the RBOC
treatment_plan: Vendor review; exclude critical rooms; RBOC override and alerting (P10)
owner: Group building technology director

threat_event: Investor owners lose confidence because the management service cannot show independent assurance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 report or system description for third-party management (P09)
treatment_plan: SOC 2 readiness and Type 1 by 2027-06-30 (P09)
owner: Commercial Property vice president of third-party management

threat_event: Card numbers are written on paper or emailed at event desks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Event desks at 11 properties take phone bookings
treatment_plan: Payment links instead of paper; mailbox search and purge
owner: Commercial Property controller

threat_event: A P2PE terminal is tampered with or swapped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented terminal inspections at 9 of 22 offices
treatment_plan: Monthly inspection logs; tamper training
owner: Commercial Property controller

threat_event: The guard contractor's shared remote video login is misused or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared login for 40 guard supervisors; no MFA
treatment_plan: Named accounts with MFA for guard supervisors; contract security addendum
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: Tenant app accounts are taken over and mobile credentials issued to the wrong person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password-only sign-in for tenant app users
existing_controls: Credential issuance requires tenant administrator approval
treatment_plan: MFA for the tenant app
owner: Commercial Property vice president of property management

threat_event: Fraudulent tenant bank change redirects a rent refund or security deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank changes accepted from tenant contacts by email
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for tenant bank changes
owner: Commercial Property controller

threat_event: A life-safety interface is changed through the BAS at sites where the read-only assumption is wrong
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Relay points verified read-only at only 60% of properties
existing_controls: Fire alarm panels independent of the BAS
treatment_plan: Verify every interface is read-only with the fire alarm vendor; document in site diagrams
owner: Commercial Property vice president of engineering

threat_event: A security console operator misuses video
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Video access logged but not reviewed
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; quarterly review under GR-16
owner: Commercial Property security and compliance lead

threat_event: The division misses tenant lease notice clauses (72 hours for 410 tenants) after a badge data incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant notice clauses not loaded into the notification matrix
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
treatment_plan: Load lease clauses into the P08 matrix; template notices
owner: Commercial Property vice president of property management

threat_event: The access control platform vendor has a regional outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor; door controllers cache credentials for 72 hours
existing_controls: Vendor multi-region service; offline door operation
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: offline operation covers 72 hours
owner: Commercial Property security and compliance lead

threat_event: The parking operator suffers a card breach that tenants attribute to the landlord
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operator is merchant of record; group has no oversight of its PCI status
treatment_plan: Require the operator's annual PCI DSS attestation and breach notice clause at renewal
owner: Commercial Property vice president of property management

threat_event: Legacy proximity badges are cloned to enter tenant floors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 125 kHz proximity badges still in use at 19 older properties
treatment_plan: Replace readers and badges with encrypted smart credentials
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: Hurricane damage destroys site OT and network equipment at coastal properties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Head-end equipment in basements at 12 coastal properties
treatment_plan: Insurance plus relocating head-end equipment above flood level at renovation
owner: Commercial Property vice president of engineering

threat_event: An OT incident at a property cannot be investigated because site logs are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Site logs roll over in days
treatment_plan: Forward site logs to the SIEM (with GR-09)
owner: Group SOC director

threat_event: Malware reaches an engineering workstation on a USB drive and spreads to the BAS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB storage allowed on engineering workstations at about half the sites
treatment_plan: Block USB storage; approved transfer kiosk per region
owner: Group OT security lead

threat_event: Properties acquired in 2024 and 2025 are operated below the OT standard for years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT onboarding milestone in acquisition integration plans
treatment_plan: Add OT onboarding to acquisition integration with a 12-month deadline
owner: Commercial Property security and compliance lead
